description_en: Queries monitoring data including the amount of network traffic and the number of visits by directory
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainPathData按目录维度获取监控数据，包括流量和访问次数
name: DescribeDomainPathData

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: integers from 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
分页大小。
取值：1~1000之间的任意整数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The paths that you want to query. Separate paths with forward slashes (/). If you do not set this parameter, all paths are queried. If you set the value to a directory, it must end with a forward slash (/).

Fuzzy match is not supported. If you want data to be collected based on a directory, you can specify a specific directory, for example, directory/path/. In this case, bandwidth data is collected based on directory/path/
parameters.help_zh:
路径，以正斜线（/）开头，不填表示查询所有路径。如果路径是目录，需要以正斜线（/）结尾。

路径信息不支持模糊匹配，需要指定查询的目录深度，只能设置为一个固定值，例如设置一级目录/path/，表示数据统计时，固定统计一级目录的带宽
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. Example: 2016-10-20T04:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。
例如：2016-10-20T04:00:00Z
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The interval between the start time and end time must be less than 30 days. Example: 2016-10-21T04:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。开始时间和结束时间，间隔小于30天。例如：2016-10-21T04:00:00Z
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

You can specify only one domain name in each call
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。
仅支持单个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range during which data was queried

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page. Pages start from page 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range during which data was queried

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
